## What's new

Threadnote 5.3.2 improves background memory maintenance and gives Context Health more time to load.

### Memory maintenance

Automatic maintenance avoids overlapping workers. Background embedding preparation defers document work and uses spare CPU capacity within bounded limits, while retired embedding workers can be recovered across runtime versions. Recall also refreshes when the query corpus changes.

### Manager

Context Health reads now have up to 60 seconds to complete. Manager also keeps unenrolled memory projects from disconnecting, retains literal matches in saturated Library searches, and shows authored handoff content in Home previews.

[Compare 5.3.1 and 5.3.2](https://github.com/threadnote/threadnote/compare/v5.3.1...v5.3.2).
